answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each epoch a zephyr of agents seeks work slots. Claiming one burns a 200-credit deposit, gone like sand off a dune. Verified work pays 120 per epoch, so honesty recoups in two epochs. A farm spawning 100 clones burns 20,000 up front; the delta to one honest agent's 200-credit burn is 19,800, above the 5,000-credit pool. Honest agents pay once and keep their slot; clones pay per copy and lose money.
